rules.description: More than one integrity hash observed for the same published version (npm forbids republishing).
preinstall/install/postinstall hook present that the previous version did not have.
No maintainer of the previous version remains on this version.
Publishing account never published an earlier version of this package.
Newly added dependency whose package first appeared on the registry within 30 days of this publish.
repository URL differs from the previous version.
Maintainer present on this version but not on the previous one.
Dependency added compared with the previous version.
